posts.headline: Eight straight editions chronicling the fall of One Nut Barner, and Put it in Ra is STILL 0-2 — a 20-8, 1.5-average-finish pedigree now looks like a fluke of history.
posts.detail: This franchise came in with the best career record and average finish in the entire league at 20-8 and 1.5, and it's produced exactly zero wins through two weeks of 2026.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 2-0 with a league-high 344.18 points and I refuse to stop saying it until this league starts respecting triciagloston.
posts.detail: A middle-tier team with a career finish of 5th is out here outscoring every contender in the building by double digits, and the silence around it is deafening.

posts.headline: Sasinci is 1-1 but Big Head's title banner is still buried — a 13-15 career record doesn't get fixed by one flukey win.
posts.detail: Alxgalvn owns a title but a sub-.500 career mark and a 5.5 average finish, and 245.38 points this year isn't enough to convince anyone the Megamind is back.

posts.headline: Thicks is 2-0 for the eighth straight edition of this column doubting him, and 263.62 points still isn't the number a reigning champion should be posting.
posts.detail: A 1-2 title-to-seasons ratio and a career mark of 14-14 means Tyrique14 has exactly one great year on his resume — right now this looks like survival, not a repeat.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 0-2 with a league-worst 165.84 points, and Auntie Thomas keeps confirming his 10-average-finish résumé was no accident.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record and dead-last scoring through two weeks means the bottom-feeder tag isn't just deserved, it's underselling the disaster.
